title_zh: RailWeave 三项重点项目交付账本
title_en: RailWeave Delivery Ledger for Three Priority Projects
authority_boundary_zh: 本账本只汇编既有概念项目台账、成本取证计划和责任接续记录，不新增主体、预算、价格、场地、现场调查、采购、合作或实施事实。三个项目均停留在G0前置核验状态；所有角色均为待依法任命的原型。工程量、单价、预算资金、采购合同、场地权利、专业条件和现场绩效未确认前，不得转段或表述为已具备实施条件。
authority_boundary_en: This ledger only compiles the existing conceptual project register, cost-evidence plan, and responsibility-handoff records. It adds no entity, budget, price, site, field-survey, procurement, partnership, or implementation fact. All three projects remain at the G0 prerequisite-verification stage, and every role is an archetype awaiting lawful appointment. No project may advance or be described as implementable until quantities, unit prices, budget funding, procurement contracts, site rights, professional conditions, and field performance are confirmed.

global_confirmation_status.status_zh: 主体未任命，预算未批准或落实，价格未确认，场地与权利未核验，现场条件未调查，采购或合同未形成，项目未获实施授权且未启动。
global_confirmation_status.status_en: Entities are unassigned; budgets are neither approved nor secured; prices are unconfirmed; sites and rights are unverified; field conditions are not surveyed; no procurement or contract is confirmed; and implementation is neither authorised nor started.
